build.beforeDevCommand: npm run bins && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run bins:release && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; frame-src blob:; object-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Workspace for the work you do with AI coding agents
bundle.longDescription: Workboard keeps one folder per piece of work, shows its state from the README frontmatter and runs agent sessions that update it through an MCP server.
